releaseNotes: Cut the repository's own story over to the engine-first direction. README.md and docs/architecture.md are rewritten around what the repository now demonstrably is: a typed workflow-graph engine (catalog, compiler, frontier, reducer, sessions) driven by agents through the formation CLI and the formation-mcp server, with platform/ as one consumer through the typed adapter boundary. AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md carry the same reversal, and the no-engine vocabulary rule is scoped to where it always belonged: founder-visible copy never speaks internal vocabulary, while maintainer-facing material calls the engine the engine.

Point-in-time material moved to docs/history per the repository's own convention: the SaaS-era backlog (replaced by docs/engine-backlog.md, ranked by how much each item changes autonomous operation, with reproduce commands), the original-repository audit, and the pre-rename loop-dryrun log. docs/method/skill-workflow-loops.md — a current-tense method doc pointing at a deleted source tree and two npm scripts that no longer exist — is rewritten against the real catalog loop. The six platform docs gain a direction note rather than a rewrite: their platform mechanics remain accurate; their premise no longer leads the repository.
